description: Sun Quan, stately chinese ruler in the supplied pixel art style. Brown hair in a topknot with a gold crown, a crimson robe with gold trim over dark armor, a long dark purple cape, dark boots. He holds a long straight sword in the right hand
face: A broad face with a full reddish-brown beard.
rear_detail: Seen from behind: brown hair with the gold crown, the long dark purple cape with crimson edges covering the back, the sword at his right side.
guard_action: the right hand lifts the sword up in front of the body, the left hand stays free, the left foot settles half a step forward

actions.idle: Commander ready stance with a one-handed sword, breathing
actions.move: Seamless combat run in place carrying the sword, no attack. The last frame leads into the first, no pause
actions.b1: Left-hand signal. The sword stays low at the right side. Frames 1-6 the LEFT arm winds back; frame 8 the left hand is thrown forward, palm out, giving the signal; frames 9-11 hold. Nothing is struck. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The sword stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.a3: Direct diagonal cut. Frames 1-5 the sword is raised to the upper right; frames 6-8 a big step and a cut from upper right to lower left; frames 9-11 follow through. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The sword stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.b3: Direct thrust. Frames 1-5 the sword is drawn back beside the hip; frames 6-8 a big step and a straight thrust, point first; frames 9-11 hold the reach. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The sword stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.s2: Lord of the east. Frames 1-6 he gathers, sword lowered across the body; frame 8 he sweeps the sword out level in a wide protective arc; frames 9-12 hold. Nothing is struck. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The sword stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.a2: Raised command. The sword is lifted high above the head and swept down to point at the target; he holds the point on it.

notes: 2026-11-19 make_configs.py. 평타 b1 → a3 → b3, 전법 s2. 무기 좌표는 원화에서 눈으로 잰 값(±2px), 가려진 끝은 추정.
